description: This file defines API service functions for interacting with backend endpoints related to classes, bookings, memberships, and development authentication. It exports asynchronous functions that perform CRUD operations for each resource via HTTP methods, utilizing an imported API client. It also sets an authorization token link.

methods.description: Fetches a list of classes from the API.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific class by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new class with provided payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing class by ID with new data.
